articles.description: 吴说获悉，据 Christine Kim 对第 203 次以太坊执行层核心开发者会议 (ACDE) 的总结，本次会议主要讨论了：Pectra 测试网升级计划（提议在 2 月 3 日前准备 Sepolia 和 Holesky 测试网的客户端版本，2 月中旬至下旬进行分叉。若无重大问题，Pectra 升级预计可在 3 月初至中旬上线主网）；Pectra Devnet 5 已启动；Pectra 规范更新（EIP 7623: 明确 calldata 成本更新中的 gas 退款处理，已在 GitHub 合并并纳入 Pectra Devnet 5 测试。EIP 7840: 关于添加 blob 时间表到客户端配置文件的更改，未有异议，计划在 1 月 20 日前完成合并。EIP 7691: 确定 blob 基础费用计算应在分叉边界之后一个区块激活，避免旧规则数据干扰。EIP 2537: 明确乘法成本计算中应使用整数除法，规范修改计划于 1 月 20 日前完成。EIP 7702: 提议启用代码自省功能以支持更安全的 relayer 使用。开发者同意进一步评估，待周一测试会议讨论）；Pectra 系统合约审计已完成，无重大问题；建议将 Holesky 默认 gas 限制设置为 36m 等。https://www.wublock123.com/index.php?m=content&c=index&a=show&catid=6&id=36544

RT Tell It Now
Re As a boomer, I am never going to lecture anyone.  I bought a 5 BR home in an close in West coast large city metro neighborhood for 42K. IF truly adjusted for inflation, it should be 150k at most today.  If you look on Zillow, it is 650k, now.
Barely 5% of the population can afford that.
Globalist neoliberalism killed the working class and is why I support Trump.  Hire American, create opportunity for Americans and kill the H1-Bs.  Academia failed. Youth, today, have been degraded and pushed aside by the elite class and deserve a country that puts their own people first.
DEI and H1-Bs and other visa programs have shunted talent here to the sidelines and modern liberalism has further decayed the social fabric...I did have it easier, not going to lie...

The slavery of white collar work - required presence in office of 70-80 hours, available at all times via phone even on vacation - is a direct consequence of college debt.
Universities set up young people as indentured servants to corporations. They have no choice but to sign away existence because that’s the only way to pay off the outrageous price of universities and professional schools. They are in debt, have to pay it off.
This entire system is a scam that older people didn’t experience. Talk to your grandparents who went to college. They either had no debt or so little that it didn’t impact their career choices.
